about_short_description.short_description: Cloudthread is a cloud cost observability platform to eliminate cloud waste, track savings, engage engineers, and activate Cloud FinOps

product.name: Cloudthread Cloud Cost Observability Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that aggregates cloud cost and usage data to identify cost-saving opportunities, track savings, and engage engineering teams in cloud financial operations (FinOps).

product.name: Savings Opportunities by Category
product.description: A feature that aggregates and categorizes cloud cost waste opportunities, providing a summarized view to identify major areas of cloud cost inefficiency.

product.name: Budgets
product.description: A budgeting tool within Cloudthread that enables setting, visualizing, and reporting cloud cost budgets for teams with notifications for budget thresholds.

product.name: Single Sign-On (SSO) Support
product.description: An enterprise feature that enables secure and streamlined user authentication for Cloudthread via integration with organizational SSO providers.

identifier.value: Unit Metrics for Cloud Cost Efficiency

product.name: Unit Metrics for Cloud Cost Efficiency
product.description: A service that generates and manages cloud cost unit metrics to measure cost relative to technical or business drivers, aiding in cost efficiency analysis and forecasting.

product.name: Cloud FinOps Framework Implementation Support
product.description: Guidance and tools within Cloudthread to help organizations establish and maintain Cloud FinOps practices for cost governance, monitoring, and optimization.
